question:
Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options: Hampi - Karnataka
Bhimbetka - Chhattisgarh
Fatehpur Sikri - Uttar Pradesh
Konark - Odisha
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bhimbetka - Chhattisgarh

Explanation:
The Bhimbetka rock shelters are located in the Raisen district of Madhya Pradesh, not Chhattisgarh. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its prehistoric cave paintings, dating back nearly 30,000 years, depicting scenes of hunting, dancing, and animals. The other options are correctly matched: Hampi (Karnataka), Fatehpur Sikri (Uttar Pradesh), and Konark (Odisha).

Extra Facts:
Bhimbetka was discovered in 1957-58 by Dr. Vishnu Shridhar Wakankar. The site provides evidence of human activity from the Paleolithic to the Medieval period. The paintings use red, white, and green colors derived from natural minerals. It is protected by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा युग्म गलत सुमेलित है?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options_hi: हम्पी - कर्नाटक
भीमबेटका - छत्तीसगढ़
फतेहपुर सीकरी - उत्तर प्रदेश
कोणार्क - ओडिशा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है भीमबेटका - छत्तीसगढ़

Explanation:
भीमबेटका की गुफाएँ मध्य प्रदेश के रायसेन जिले में स्थित हैं, न कि छत्तीसगढ़ में। यह एक यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल है जिसमें प्रागैतिहासिक काल के शैलचित्र पाए जाते हैं। यहाँ लगभग 30,000 वर्ष पुराने चित्र मिले हैं, जो मुख्यतः शिकार, नृत्य और जानवरों को दर्शाते हैं। अन्य विकल्प सही सुमेलित हैं: हम्पी (कर्नाटक), फतेहपुर सीकरी (उत्तर प्रदेश), और कोणार्क (ओडिशा)।

Extra Facts:
भीमबेटका को 1957-58 में डॉ. विष्णु श्रीधर वाकणकर द्वारा खोजा गया था। यह स्थल पुरापाषाण काल से मध्यकालीन युग तक मानव गतिविधियों का प्रमाण देता है। यहाँ के चित्रों में लाल, सफेद और हरे रंग का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो प्राकृतिक रंगों से बने थे। यह स्थल भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण (ASI) द्वारा संरक्षित है।

question:
____________was the capital city of the Vijaynagar Empire.

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Magadha
Kanchi
Hampi
Kalyani
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hampi

Explanation:
The capital of the Vijayanagara Empire (1336-1646 CE) was Hampi, located in present-day Karnataka. The empire was founded by Harihara and Bukka. Hampi was a prosperous and magnificent city, also known as the 'City of Victory'. The famous Virupaksha Temple and Vittala Temple are outstanding examples of its architecture. In 1565 CE, the empire declined after the Battle of Talikota, leading to the destruction of Hampi.

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagara Empire was ruled by the 'Sangama Dynasty', 'Saluva Dynasty', 'Tuluva Dynasty', and 'Aravidu Dynasty'. Krishnadevaraya (1509-1529 CE) was its greatest ruler, who authored the 'Amuktamalyada'. The empire fought several wars against the Deccan Sultanates.

question_hi:
____________विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी थी।

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options_hi: मगध
कांची
हम्पी
कल्याणी
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है हम्पी

Explanation:
विजयनगर साम्राज्य (1336-1646 ई.) की राजधानी हम्पी थी, जो वर्तमान कर्नाटक राज्य में स्थित है। इस साम्राज्य की स्थापना हरिहर और बुक्का ने की थी। हम्पी अपने समय में एक समृद्ध और वैभवशाली नगर था, जिसे 'विजयनगर' (विजय का शहर) कहा जाता था। यहाँ के प्रसिद्ध विरुपाक्ष मंदिर और विट्ठल मंदिर इसकी स्थापत्य कला के उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हैं। 1565 ई. में तालीकोटा की लड़ाई में विजयनगर साम्राज्य का पतन हो गया, जिसके बाद हम्पी को नष्ट कर दिया गया।

Extra Facts:
विजयनगर साम्राज्य को 'संगम वंश', 'सालुव वंश', 'तुलुव वंश' और 'अरविदु वंश' ने संभाला। कृष्णदेव राय (1509-1529 ई.) इस साम्राज्य का सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक था, जिसने 'अमुक्तमाल्यद' नामक ग्रंथ की रचना की। विजयनगर साम्राज्य ने दक्कन के सुल्तानों के खिलाफ कई युद्ध लड़े।

question:
Who wrote 'Masterpieces of Vijayanagara Art' ?

[RPF SI 2024]
options: Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara
RK Narayan
Pranab Chandra Roy
Dr. V Ganapathi Sthapathi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara

Explanation:
'Masterpieces of Vijayanagara Art' is a significant book on the art and architecture of the Vijayanagara Empire, written by Dr. Sindigi Rajasekhara. This book provides detailed insights into the rich artistic heritage of Vijayanagara, including temple architecture, sculptures, and paintings. The Vijayanagara Empire (1336-1646 CE) was a prominent Hindu kingdom in South India that patronized art and culture. Dr. Rajasekhara's work highlights the unique artistic style and historical significance of Vijayanagara's contributions.

Extra Facts:
Vijayanagara art is renowned for its temples in Hampi (Vittala Temple, Virupaksha Temple) and stone chariots. The period saw a blend of Dravidian and Hoysala styles. Under Krishnadevaraya (1509-1529 CE), art and literature flourished.

question:
The Vijayanagar kingdom was established by _________ in 1336.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Venkata II
Devaraya II
Harihara and Bukka
Krishnadevaraya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Harihara and Bukka

Explanation:
The Vijayanagar Empire was established in 1336 CE by Harihara I and Bukka Raya. It was a prominent Hindu kingdom in South India, founded to protect Hindu culture against the Delhi Sultanate. These two brothers were originally commanders of the Kakatiya dynasty and later became the founders of the Vijayanagara Empire. The empire ruled until the 17th century, with its capital at Hampi, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagar Empire was also called the Karnata Kingdom. Its rulers promoted art, literature, and architecture. Krishnadevaraya (1509-1529) was its most famous ruler, who patronized the 'Ashtadiggaja' poets. In 1565, the empire faced defeat in the Battle of Talikota (Rakshasa-Tangadi War) against the Deccan Sultanates, leading to its decline.

Extra Facts:

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagara Empire is famous for the ruins of Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The empire reached its peak under Krishnadevaraya (Tuluva Dynasty), a great warrior and patron of arts. The Vijayanagara army effectively used cavalry and artillery.

question:
Who among the following founded the Saluva dynasty of Vijayanagara empire?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Rama Deva Raya
Narsimha Deva Raya
Bukka Raya I
Krishanadeva Raya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Narsimha Deva Raya

Explanation:
The Saluva dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire was founded by Narsimha Deva Raya in 1485 CE. This dynasty came to power after the Sangama dynasty. question:
What was the dominant source of income in the Vijaynagar Empire?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Mining
Industrial duty
Land revenue
Import duty
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Land revenue

Explanation:
The dominant source of income in the Vijayanagar Empire (1336-1646 CE) was land revenue. The empire was agrarian-based, and its economy primarily relied on agricultural production. The state collected a fixed share of the produce (ranging from 1/6 to 1/3) as tax from farmers. Additionally, irrigation systems like dams and canals were built to enhance agricultural output. The Vijayanagar rulers developed a systematic land measurement and assessment system called 'Amaram'.

Extra Facts:
Though trade in spices, gems, and textiles was significant, land revenue remained the empire's largest income source. Krishnadeva Raya (1509-1529 CE), the greatest ruler of Vijayanagar, emphasized agriculture and irrigation, boosting the empire's prosperity.

After the Sangama dynasty, the Saluva, Tuluva, and Aravidu dynasties ruled the empire. question:

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1565 AD

Explanation:
The Battle of Talikota was fought on 23rd January, 1565 AD between the Vijayanagara Empire and the combined forces of the Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, and Bidar). The battle took place near Talikota (present-day Karnataka) on the banks of the Krishna River. The Vijayanagara Empire was led by King Sadasiva Raya and his commander Rama Raya, but they were defeated. This battle marked the beginning of the decline of the Vijayanagara Empire, and the Deccan Sultanates looted and destroyed the capital city of Hampi.

Extra Facts:
The Battle of Talikota is also known as the 'Battle of Rakshasa-Tangadi'. The Vijayanagara army had a large number of elephants and cavalry, but the Deccan Sultanates effectively used artillery and gunpowder to defeat them. This battle was a turning point in Indian history as it led to the dominance of Muslim powers in South India.

question:
Which battle led to the destruction of the Vijayanagara empire?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Battle of Raichur
Battle of Haldighati
Battle of Talikota
Battle of Arcot
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Battle of Talikota

Explanation:
The Battle of Talikota (1565 CE) was the decisive conflict that led to the downfall of the Vijayanagara Empire. It was fought between the Vijayanagara Empire and the combined forces of the Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, and Bidar). The Vijayanagara king Rama Raya was defeated and killed in this battle. Following the defeat, the capital city of Vijayanagara was plundered and destroyed, marking the end of the empire's dominance. This battle was a turning point in Indian history as it established Muslim supremacy in South India.

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by Harihara and Bukka in 1336 CE. It reached its zenith under Krishnadeva Raya (1509-1529 CE). The empire was renowned for its grand temples, architecture, and trade. Although remnants of the empire survived after Talikota, it never regained its former glory.

Hampi is renowned for its grand temples, massive gopurams, and architectural marvels, including the Vittala Temple and Virupaksha Temple.

Extra Facts:
Hampi served as the center of the Vijayanagara Empire from the 14th to the 16th century. The Hazara Rama Temple was built by Krishnadevaraya, one of the empire's most powerful rulers. After the Battle of Talikota (1565), the empire declined, and Hampi was destroyed.

In return, they recruited soldiers and provided military support to the king during wars. This system was based on a feudal structure and formed the backbone of the Vijayanagara Empire's military strength. Under rulers like Krishnadeva Raya, this system brought stability and expansion to the empire.

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagara Empire (1336–1646 CE) was a prominent Hindu empire in South India, founded by Harihara and Bukka. Its capital was Hampi, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Amara-Nayaka system played a key role in the decentralized administration of the empire, but later, these Nayakas began asserting independence, leading to the empire's decline.

question:
Tirumala Raya was the founder of which of the following dynasties in ancient India?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Saluva
Sangama
Tuluva
Aravidu
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Aravidu

Explanation:
Tirumala Raya was the founder of the Aravidu dynasty in the Vijayanagara Empire. He established this dynasty in 1542 CE. As the last ruling dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire, the Aravidu dynasty ruled until the 17th century. Tirumala Raya attempted to revive the empire, but due to pressure from the Bahmani Sultanate and other invaders, the empire eventually declined.

Extra Facts:
The Vijayanagara Empire was a great Hindu empire in South India, founded in 1336 CE by Harihara and Bukka Raya of the Sangama dynasty. Its capital was Hampi, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The empire made remarkable contributions to art, literature, and architecture.

question_hi:
तिरुमाला राय प्राचीन भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किस राजवंश के संस्थापक थे?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: सालुवा
संगम:
तुलुवा
अराविदु
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है अराविदु

Explanation:
तिरुमाला राय विजयनगर साम्राज्य के अराविदु वंश के संस्थापक थे। उन्होंने 1542 ईस्वी में इस वंश की स्थापना की थी। विजयनगर साम्राज्य के अंतिम शासकीय वंश के रूप में अराविदु वंश ने 17वीं शताब्दी तक शासन किया। तिरुमाला राय ने विजयनगर साम्राज्य को पुनर्जीवित करने का प्रयास किया, लेकिन बहमनी सल्तनत और अन्य आक्रमणकारियों के दबाव के कारण साम्राज्य का पतन हो गया।

Extra Facts:
विजयनगर साम्राज्य दक्षिण भारत का एक महान हिंदू साम्राज्य था, जिसकी स्थापना 1336 ईस्वी में संगम वंश के हरिहर और बुक्का राय ने की थी। इस साम्राज्य की राजधानी हम्पी थी, जो यूनेस्को की विश्व धरोहर स्थल है। विजयनगर साम्राज्य ने कला, साहित्य और वास्तुकला के क्षेत्र में उल्लेखनीय योगदान दिया।
